name: national-cleft-registry
description: National Cleft Registry - Ghana: Main Hub + Regional Hub

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix "Main Hub" ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix "Regional Hub" ci --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.build: npm --prefix "Main Hub" run build && npm --prefix "Regional Hub" run build
scripts.check: npm --prefix "Main Hub" run typecheck && npm --prefix "Main Hub" run lint && npm --prefix "Regional Hub" run typecheck && npm --prefix "Regional Hub" run lint
